title: Wire WritingStyle 8D structured style to backend prompt builder
description: F3 WritingStyle Integration: Export structured 8D style object from WritingStyle.ts alongside existing flat string. Create MCP endpoint to accept structured style. Update writing.js prompt builder to consume structured style object for richer prompt assembly.
action: Add buildStructuredStyle() export to WritingStyle.ts returning 8D object, create POST /writing/style-structured MCP endpoint in writing.js consuming structured style for prompt assembly, update frontend api/evaluation.ts or create new api/style.ts to call structured endpoint

criteria: writing.js contains endpoint handler for structured style input
writing.js buildModePrompt consumes structured style object with 8D fields
Existing buildStyleInstruction() flat-string path still works unchanged
convergence.verification: Call writing endpoint with structured style object, verify prompt contains 8D style fields. Call with flat string instruction, verify backward compat.
convergence.definition_of_done: Backend prompt builder consumes 8D structured style; flat-string fallback still works

files.change: Add export function buildStructuredStyle(style: WritingStyleConfig) returning { tone, perspective, sentenceStyle, rhythm, languageStyle, narrativeDistance, emotionalResonance, thematicDepth } object mirroring the TypeScript interface types.

Add handling for structured_style field in request body. When structured_style present, build prompt from individual dimensions instead of flat string. Keep existing instruction string path as fallback.

implementation: In WritingStyle.ts: add export function buildStructuredStyle(style) that returns the 8D style object { tone: style.tone, perspective: style.perspective, sentenceStyle: style.sentenceStyle, rhythm: style.rhythm, languageStyle: style.languageStyle, narrativeDistance: style.narrativeDistance, emotionalResonance: style.emotionalResonance, thematicDepth: style.thematicDepth }
In writing.js endpoint registration: add new endpoint or extend existing writing endpoint to accept structured_style POST body

unit: buildStructuredStyle returns object with all 8 dimensions
integration: POST to writing endpoint with structured_style, verify prompt contains 8D fields

reference.pattern: MCP endpoint pattern in writing.js: async function returning jsonResponse(result)
reference.examples: writing.js line 14-30 shows current styleSection = instruction flat string consumption

rationale.chosen_approach: Add structured export alongside flat string, consume both in backend
decision_factors: 8D style system is 340 lines but outputs only flat string
Backend prompt builder can use individual dimensions for richer prompts
Backward compat requires keeping flat string path
rationale.tradeoffs: Two code paths in buildModePrompt, but structured path is strictly additive

risks.risk: Structured style fields not matching TypeScript interface exactly
risks.mitigation: Mirror WritingStyle.ts interface types exactly in transport object
